b = -2

# Check constraints: k must be an integer >= 2
if abs(k1 - 30) < 1e-9 and k1 >= 2:
    print("k1 = 30 is a valid solution.")
else:
    print("k1 is not a valid solution.")

if abs(k2) < 1e-9:
